_comment: Source catalogue. In the internet profile a source runs only if allowed=true, and HTTP requests may go only to the listed hosts (suffix match). rate_per_min is enforced per host. 'removal' is used by the phase 3 planner.

sources.tos: Official API, paid key. Lowest tier is 10 requests/min. Owner's own address.
sources.removal: breach: cannot be removed; rotate password + 2FA. HIBP offers opt-out from public search at haveibeenpwned.com/OptOut

sources.tos: HIBP Pwned Passwords range API (free, k-anonymity): only a 5-char SHA-1 prefix is sent; used by `leakguard password-check`.
sources.removal: n/a

sources.tos: JustDeleteMe open dataset (jdm-contrib/jdm on GitHub): delete-account links; downloaded by `leakguard remove status` (refreshed every 30 days).
sources.removal: n/a

sources.tos: Official API, free tier with daily quota. Intelligent search only matches selectors (email, domain, URL, IP, phone...), not bare words.
sources.removal: IntelX removal request form: intelx.io/removal (per record)

sources.tos: Official Custom Search JSON API, 100 free queries/day. DISABLED 2026-11-26: Google returns 403 'This project does not have the access to Custom Search JSON API' (closed to new projects).
sources.removal: ask site owner; then Google Remove Outdated Content / Results about you

sources.tos: Official Brave Search API, own web index. Free tier about 1 request/second, monthly quota.
sources.removal: ask site owner; then search-engine removal (Google 'Results about you', Bing content removal)

sources.tos: Public API, no key, low rate.
sources.removal: breach: rotate password

sources.tos: Public Pastebin dump search. Service is often down; failures are expected. DISABLED 2026-11-26: psbdmp.ws has no A record (service offline).
sources.removal: Pastebin abuse report on the original paste

sources.tos: Public profile API.
sources.removal: delete or hide profile at gravatar.com (log in with the email)

sources.tos: Public keyserver lookup.
sources.removal: keys.openpgp.org: manage via email verification; SKS/Ubuntu: cannot delete, only revoke

sources.tos: Official REST search API. 10 searches/min unauthenticated, 30 with GITHUB_TOKEN.
sources.removal: own repos: git-filter-repo + noreply email; others: ask repo owner or GitHub private-info removal form

sources.tos: Public search pages of brokers listed in the profile. Hosts come from each broker entry.
sources.removal: broker opt-out form or GDPR/CCPA erasure email
